title: Book of the Azure Court Glaive
summary: The school's opening book of court salutes, paired cuts and measured paces, ending in its Signature rite.

title: Glaive Rites of the Paired Hawk
summary: Teaches the glaive hunt of a lead stroke and a trailing stroke, ending in the school's rite of two stoops.

title: Basin and Blade: The Twin-Court Glaive Treatise
summary: A treatise on holding the basin of the guard with blade and butt, closing with the school's basin rite.

title: Seven Crossings of the River Glaive
summary: Teaches seven cuts that cross the foe's front like a river crossing, completed by the school's crossing rite.

title: The Dual-Track Crescent of the High Azure
summary: A Xiantian manual of crescents struck on two tracks beneath the high azure sky, closing with the school's rite.

title: Core Crescent of the Azure Court
summary: The court's highest glaive text, drawing crescents from a formed core and ending in its Signature rite.

title: Oath-Book of the Plateau Glaive
summary: A book of oath-sworn cuts, guards and presses taught on bare stone, ending in the school's crescent rite.

title: Glaive Rites of the Wind-Sworn Line
summary: Teaches the fighter to keep every stroke to one sworn line, closing with the school's rite of the line.

title: Bearing, Oath and Blade: The Gale Glaive Treatise
summary: A treatise binding bearing, oath and blade into one act, closing with the school's rite of bearing and oath.

title: The Open-Country Glaive Canon
summary: Teaches the glaive across open plain with no cover to the foe, closing with the canon's rite.

title: Crescent of the Long Plateau Wind
summary: A Xiantian manual of crescents borne on the long wind of the plateau, closing with the school's rite.

title: Core Gale Crescent of the Sworn Edge
summary: The school's highest glaive text, drawing a gale-crescent from a formed core and sworn to its full length.
